answer: Because the whisper height is fixed at intake and recorded in the jade receipt, the onyx audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 279 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which costs it the epoch. That is 25 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
